components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid accent button for the single primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E63346; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C41F31; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E63346; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Subtle Button
components.css: .ds-btn-subtle { background: #0D1B2A; color: #94A3B8; border: 1px solid #1F3046; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-subtle:hover { color: #F8FAFC; border-color: #2A3F5A; }

components.css: .ds-tile { background: #1B2A3D; border: 1px solid #2A3F5A; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.1s; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: #E63346; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-tile-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-tile-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-tile-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #94A3B8; } .ds-tile-divider { border-top: 1px solid #2A3F5A; } .ds-tile-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-tag { padding: 3px 8px; background: #06101A; border: 1px solid #2A3F5A; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #94A3B8; } .ds-badge-green { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(34,197,94,0.18); border: 1px solid #22C55E; color: #22C55E; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: #06101A; border: 1px solid #1F3046; color: #94A3B8; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-active { background: rgba(230,51,70,0.16); border: 1px solid #E63346; color: #E63346; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(230,51,70,0.16); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field with focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #06101A; border: 1px solid #1F3046; border-radius: 8px; color: #F8FAFC; padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #E63346; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230,51,70,0.18); }

components.name: KPI Tile
components.description: Top-border-accented stat tile, clickable to drill into the related page.
components.css: .ds-kpi { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 140px; background: #1B2A3D; border: 1px solid #2A3F5A; border-top: 3px solid #E63346; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: inherit; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #94A3B8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-kpi-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #94A3B8; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Detail Bottom Sheet
components.description: Signature DetailModal: slide-up panel with optional accent top border.
components.css: .ds-sheet-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; } .ds-sheet { background: #1B2A3D; border-top: 3px solid #22C55E; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px; width: 100%; max-width: 600px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-sheet-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-sheet-close { background: none; border: none; color: #94A3B8; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 4px; }

narrative.overview: The app reads like the clubroom after the lights are mostly down and one lamp is left on over the registration desk: a near-black navy field, a single disciplined red accent, and nothing else competing for attention. This is a tool a trainer reaches for one-handed between rounds, not a brand experience — every screen rejects decoration in favor of the same handful of repeating structural patterns (tile-grid, detail page, bottom-sheet, tabs) so that once a user has learned one page, they have learned all of them. The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS dashboard clichés: no gradient hero cards, no glassmorphism, no stock-photo dashboard widgets, no decorative empty-state illustrations beyond a single centered emoji and two lines of text. Two supported alternate themes exist behind a user-facing theme switcher, each swapping the same CSS custom properties: Kodokan (dark warm, gold accent inspired by the club logo) and Licht (a bright, inverted light theme). All three themes share one component vocabulary; only the token values change. Status colors (green/blue/orange/purple) are hardcoded and identical across all three themes, since they carry data meaning, not brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-mobile-first by default; light is an explicit opt-in, not a prefers-color-scheme default.
One accent color per theme, used sparingly (primary actions, active tab underline, focus rings, KPI top-borders).
Flat, bordered surfaces — no shadows beyond a faint ambient drop on cards and modals.
Status/data colors (green, blue, orange, purple) never change between themes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one brand accent color. It is never duplicated by a second 'secondary brand color' — variety comes from the four fixed status colors, which exist for data meaning, not decoration.

rules.name: The Theme-Invariant Status Rule
rules.body: Green/blue/orange/purple never change value across themes. A status badge must mean the same thing and look the same whether the club is on Navy, Kodokan, or Licht.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Every weight and size on screen comes from Plus Jakarta Sans. Introducing a second family for 'emphasis' is prohibited — emphasis is weight (400 → 700 → 800) and size, never typeface.

rules.name: The Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Reach for a 1px border first. A shadow is added only when a surface needs to read as 'floating above' another (modal, hover-lift on a clickable tile), never as ambient texture on static content.

dos: Do keep one primary action per screen, placed top-right of the action bar, styled with the solid accent button.
Do pair every status badge/chip with text, not color alone (colorblind-safe by construction, not as an afterthought).
Do reuse the tile-grid → detail/bottom-sheet/accordion three-pattern (STIJLGIDS.md §4) instead of inventing a new navigation shape per feature.
Do keep all three themes (Navy, Kodokan, Licht) working from the same semantic token names — never hardcode a hex value where a var(--token) exists.
Do use showToast() for action feedback; never alert() or an inline success banner.
donts: Don't introduce gradient hero cards, glassmorphism, or stock-dashboard hero-metric widgets — generic SaaS dashboard clichés are an explicit anti-reference.
Don't add a second brand accent color 'for variety.' One accent per theme; reach for the four fixed status colors instead.

Don't use a border-left/border-right colored stripe as a card accent; the system's accent-border convention is border-top, used specifically on KPI tiles and active admin-category tiles, never on list rows.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Plus Jakarta Sans only, distinguished by weight/size.
Don't let status colors shift between themes — green/blue/orange/purple are fixed regardless of Navy/Kodokan/Licht.
Don't style success/error feedback as a permanent inline banner; that's reserved for contextual, persistent page info (see alert/banner blocks), not transient action feedback.
